digital_twin.scientific_reasoning: A Digital Twin strictly requires a physical asset, real-time bidirectional data telemetry (sensor stream -> digital model -> actuation/control feedback), and continuous state synchronization (Grieves & Vickers, 2017). SimuPharm has zero physical sensors, zero instrument telemetry, and zero bidirectional coupling. It is NOT a digital twin.

virtual_instrument.scientific_reasoning: Fully conforms to the established definition of a Virtual Instrument (National Instruments / IEEE): software executing on a computer that simulates the controls, measurement physics, and analytical signal displays of a physical instrument.

in_silico_simulator.scientific_reasoning: Accurate description. The platform executes mathematical algorithms in silico to compute analytical responses from user-configured parameters.

physics_informed_model.scientific_reasoning: It implements first-principles mechanistic equations (Van Deemter, Beer-Lambert, Golay, Darcy). However, in modern literature, 'Physics-Informed' often implies Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). To avoid reviewer confusion, use 'Mechanistic Physics-Based Simulator' rather than 'Physics-Informed'.
